code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated creatinine (suggesting renal impairment), low total protein, elevated ferritin, LDH, and alkaline phosphatase, and a prolonged INR. These findings suggest acute systemic illness with hypoxic respiratory failure, possible sepsis or severe inflammatory response, and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
